questions.question: In the revised Bloom's Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001), which is the highest cognitive domain level?

options: Tasks a learner can complete independently without any external help
The difference between what a learner can do without help and what they can achieve with guidance from a skilled partner
Fixed biological stages of cognitive maturation
